label: RUDY as a feature
subgoals: Take the bounding-box width and height of the net
Divide the half-perimeter by the box area
Spread that density over every point of the box

label: From nets to a tile map
section: From nets to a tile map
subgoals: Compute each net's overlap area with the tile
Multiply each overlap by the net's density and sum
Divide by the tile area for the tile's density

label: Judging a congestion map
subgoals: Square and average the per-tile errors and take the root
Divide by the range of the actual values
Check hotspot recall separately from the map-wide error
